notes.title: Forbidden Valentine's Update! 2.14.18
notes.content:
Hello all! This is the OneShark dev team here wishing you a Happy Valentine's Day and showin' the love with a new update.

For our Italian fans, we have now localized the game to include the Italian Language!

For our Hardcore fans, we have included a new Dragon to conquer at final map!

By request of the community, to support the hardcore mode and normal mode as well.... we have included a new Shop Active Skill called "God's Blessing"! This will allow you to heal your players in battle.

There was also a negative review about experiencing too many deaths in a row, so we went into that system and touched it to include a backtrack 50 levels on death. This way you will be transported to a safer area after your death occurs, letting you get your head straight and prepare to fight again.

We will continue to work on this game throughout 2018 and we would like to thank you all for your support!

Don't forget to try: Chicken Assassin, Twist of Destiny, The Terrible Beast From the East (MMORPG in progress - playable on GameJolt)

Sincerely,

OneShark llc  ːsteamhappyː
